utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Oh yes!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Well, I'm beautiful. I'm grand. I'm fantastic.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: You want— no, don't moon the stream, Graham.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: What's that red light? If I cover that up—

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: The red light? It means it's on. So if there's no red light—

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: If there's no red light—

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Here, like, come here. Come here. Come in here.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Did you hear what I said?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yes, come here. Okay, so you see me?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: This is what they're seeing live. Okay, this is what they're seeing. So you— I don't know if they're gonna see you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: No, they can't see.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No, now they do.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Now they see me over here.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No, no, this is delayed a little bit. So that's you right there.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Delayed a little bit?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, so now you just went back.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Delayed a lot. Okay, but they can't see me over here.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No, they can only see where that camera shows.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Okay, so I put a Kleenex over that.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, if you block it, it's done. Okay, now you can take your hand away. It's going to be delayed, so you're going to see it eventually. Ready? So bam. So if you want to— if you think that people are watching you or you whatever—

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's disgusting.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Why is it disgusting? We're not doing porno or anything. They can't see you there.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: What are you doing?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: You young people are all the same, you have no sense of privacy and just want to show off your whole lives to strangers for attention.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: That's not fair, I'm just sharing a hobby! You're making it sound like something bad when it's just a community.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: This is going on YouTube. I'm putting it on YouTube. Oh man, there you go. We can play video games. All right, Graham, enough. See, you can— we could do that. We could do this all night long. This is what I do. So, and then this is people that are talking right here. So I see these people talking.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's not a good thing. Too much of your business.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Only when I want it to be out there. I'm putting that on YouTube. Did anybody there in here see this? Did anybody just see that? Am I the only one who just saw that?
